title: Shooting Variation 2 - Dribble-Touch To The Side-Shoot Side-On

source.file: archive/2026-09-21/Shooting Variation 2 - Dribble-Touch To The Side-Shoot Side-On.pdf
source.originalFilename: Shooting Variation 2 - Dribble-Touch To The Side-Shoot Side-On.pdf

setup: One large goal, three large cones or poles to represent defenders, two smaller cones (A and B) to mark where the players line up. The three cones should be: one in front of each goal post, one in the middle. Three cones distance from goal line: 8 yards for U8s and U10s, 10 yards for U12s and U14s.
instructions: Dribble toward the cone on the left side, take a touch to the side, one more touch to go past the central cone (defender), then shoot diagonally to the back post.
Do not push the ball behind the cones (defenders), but rather shoot from the space in front.
coachingPoints: Dribble with the shoe laces, toes pointing down.
Big touch to the side, parallel to the defenders - maintain a safe distance to the defenders.
Best: push the ball past the central defender - that will attract the goalie to the right goal post.
Then shoot diagonally toward the back post, using the goalie's momentum against him/her.
Reinforce all the shooting body mechanics: Shooting: step side by side with the ball, not too far, not too close.
Point the toes of the plant foot toward the target.
Big back-swing, snap the knee joint, and big follow-through swing with the kicking leg.
Swing the kicking let up and toward the desired target.
The leg swing determines the direction and accuracy of the shot.

derived.areaSize: defender cones 8 yards from goal for U8/U10, 10 yards for U12/U14
